model_annotations.Bulgarian: Този диаграма показва разпределението на персонажите в две основни категории: "Виртуални персонажи" и "Реални персонажи". Общо са изобразени 14 категории. В категорията "Виртуални персонажи" са включени: "Персонажи от комикси" (синьо), "Персонажи от филми" , "Телевизионни персонажи" , "Персонажи от романи" , "Персонажи от игри". В категорията "Реални персонажи" са включени: "Потребителски персонажи" (розово), и още осем подкатегории, които са: "Учени" , "Художници" , "Спортсмени" , "Писатели" , "Музиканти" , "Актьори" , "Инфлуенсъри". Диаграмата включва легенда и няма допълнителни проценти или етикети вътре в секторите. Няма визуално подчертани сектори. Секторите са подредени в кръг без определен ред.
model_annotations.English: This chart represents a hierarchical categorization of characters, comparing the distribution of character types within two main categories. The chart consists of 2 primary categories and 15 subcategories, with the larger categories being "Virtual Characters" and "Real Characters". The "Virtual Characters" category is further divided into 7 subcategories: "Comic Characters", "Movie Characters", "Teleplay Characters", "Novel Characters", "Game Characters", and "Custom Characters" is not a subcategory of "Virtual Characters" but rather a separate category within "Virtual Characters" that overlaps with "Real Characters". The "Real Characters" category is divided into 9 subcategories: "Scientists", "Artists", "Athletes", "Writers", "Musicians", "Actors", "Influencers", and two additional categories not labeled with percentages. The chart does not include a legend, but the colors used to differentiate the categories are blue for "Virtual Characters" and its subcategories, green for "Real Characters" and its subcategories, and pink for "Custom Characters". The chart also does not include percentage labels inside the slices, but the proportions can be estimated: "Virtual Characters" appears to be approximately 80%, and "Real Characters" appears to be approximately 20%. The segments appear to be ordered in a particular way, with the largest category being "Virtual Characters".
model_annotations.German: Das Diagramm zeigt eine Unterteilung von Charakteren in zwei Hauptkategorien: "Virtual Characters" und "Real Characters". Die Kategorie "Virtual Characters" wird in sechs Segmente unterteilt: "Comic Characters" (blau, ca. 31%), "Movie Characters" (blau, ca. 20%), "Teleplay Characters" (blau, ca. 15%), "Novel Characters" (blau, ca. 15%), "Game Characters" (blau, ca. 19%). Die Kategorie "Real Characters" wird in zwei Segmente unterteilt: "Custom Characters" (rosa, ca. 8%) und ein weiteres Segment mit neun kleineren Anteilen: "Scientists", "Artists", "Athletes", "Writers", "Musicians", "Actors", "Influencers" sowie zwei weitere nicht beschriftete Anteile (grün, ca. 5-10%). Es gibt keine Legende, aber die Segmente sind farblich differenziert. Die Segmente innerhalb der Kategorien sind nicht in einer bestimmten Reihenfolge angeordnet.
